title: Lawyers protest in Kalaburagi demanding protection act
seoTitle: Kalaburagi lawyers protest for protection act

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against increasing instances of attacks, threats, and atrocities against advocates.
tea.want: Lawyers demand a stronger Advocates Protection Act making attacks non-bailable, special courts, and better court security.
tea.changed: Nov 3: Lawyers staged a protest outside the Deputy Commissioner's office in Kalaburagi and submitted a memorandum.

summary: Members of the Gulbarga Bar Association staged a protest outside the Deputy Commissioner's office in Kalaburagi, demanding stringent measures to prevent assaults, harassment, and murder of advocates. The agitating lawyers expressed concern over rising attacks and the absence of adequate security, which hinders their professional duties. Organised by the Gulbarga Bar Association, the protest included submitting a memorandum to the district administration. Their demands include making attacks against advocates non-bailable offences with severe penalties, setting up special courts for speedy trials, and installing metal detectors and CCTV cameras across all court premises in Karnataka. Association leaders, including President S.V. Pasar, participated in the demonstration.
demands: Make attacks, intimidation, harassment and murder of advocates non-bailable offences
Provide stringent imprisonment and heavy penalties for guilty individuals
Establish special courts for speedy trials of cases involving attacks on advocates
Install metal detectors and CCTV cameras on all court premises across the State
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Gulbarga Bar Association members staged a protest outside the Deputy Commissioner's office in Kalaburagi.
